question_text:
Which of the following complex shapes contains the simple target shape of a right-angled triangle? The target triangle has legs of length 2 cm and 3 cm. The complex shapes are: 
A. A rectangle with a diagonal line from one corner to the opposite corner 
B. A trapezoid with a line connecting the midpoints of the non-parallel sides 
C. A hexagon with all sides equal and a line from one vertex to the center 
D. A pentagon with a line from one vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side

options.text: A rectangle with a diagonal line from one corner to the opposite corner
A trapezoid with a line connecting the midpoints of the non-parallel sides
A hexagon with all sides equal and a line from one vertex to the center
A pentagon with a line from one vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side
